title: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct W8A8 · Ascend 910B3

lede.zh: 单卡 Ascend 910B3 上的 Qwen3-VL-8B W8A8 测试显示，1080p 图像请求 TTFT 中位数为 2.44 秒；纯文本的 120 ms 不能代表视觉请求首 token 延迟。
lede.en: Qwen3-VL-8B W8A8 measurements on one Ascend 910B3 show a 2.44 s median TTFT for 1080p image requests. The 120 ms text-only point does not represent first-token latency for vision requests.

snapshot.zh: 文本 · 256² / 720p / 1080p 图像 · 长上下文 · 开放环

heading.zh: 对视觉模型，首 token 延迟必须附带图像输入
heading.en: For vision models, attach image inputs to TTFT

intro.zh: 文本和图像是不同预填充负载。官方文本随机输入规程不会触发视觉编码器，因此单独报告文本结果会低估图像请求的首 token 时间。
intro.en: Text and image prompts create different prefill workloads. A text-only random-input procedure does not exercise the vision encoder, so reporting only text results understates first-token time for image requests.

note.zh: 256²、720p 与 1080p 的请求数均为 128，P95 满足样本门槛。模型完整性、图像输入 token 账本与服务端指标已逐档核对；该权重/硬件组合并非官方配方已标注的组合。
note.en: The 256², 720p, and 1080p points each use 128 requests, meeting the report’s P95 sample threshold. Token accounting and server-side metrics were checked per workload; this checkpoint/hardware pairing is not listed in the official recipe.

heading.zh: 图像分辨率主要拉高 TTFT，解码 TPOT 的变化较小
heading.en: Image resolution mainly increases TTFT, while decode TPOT changes less

intro.zh: 单张 Ascend 910B3、TP1。相同服务部署下测试文本与三档图像分辨率；图像场景使用合成分辨率输入，功能验证另用真实图像。
intro.en: One Ascend 910B3 accelerator with TP1. Text and three image resolutions were measured on the same serving deployment; synthetic resolution inputs were used for performance points, with real images used separately for functional validation.

notes.zh: 1080p 图像相对纯文本测试的 TTFT 约高 20 倍，但这两种输入形状不同，不能理解为对同一请求的回归比例。图片 token 从约 74 增至约 2,050 时，主要成本出现在预填充阶段。
notes.en: The 1080p image point has roughly 20× the TTFT of the text-only test, but the input profiles differ; this is not a regression ratio for the same request. As image tokens increase from about 74 to about 2,050, most added cost appears in prefill.

title.zh: 输入形状与 TTFT 中位数

hint.en: Hover a point to inspect the measurement.

heading.zh: 单流可用；官方纯文本规程不足以代表视觉负载
heading.en: Serving works at single-stream load; a text-only recipe does not represent vision traffic

intro.zh: 性能矩阵覆盖文本、长上下文和多模态输入，并另测开环到达率。该 W8A8 权重格式未被官方配方标注为 A2 组合，因此结果属于兼容性与性能实测。
intro.en: The matrix covers text, long context, multimodal inputs, and open-loop arrivals. This W8A8 checkpoint format is not listed by the official recipe for A2, so these results are compatibility and performance measurements.

notes.zh: 图像负载的 safe_rps 使用 TTFT P95 ≤ 2 s；1080p 下为 1.75 req/s。每个点都应与分辨率和约 2,050 图像 token 的输入口径一起引用。
notes.en: Vision safe_rps uses a TTFT P95 ≤ 2 s threshold; the 1080p point is 1.75 req/s. Quote each rate with its resolution and input profile of about 2,050 image tokens.

hint.en: Hover a point to inspect the measurement.

meta.value: Synthetic resolution sweep + real-image smoke test

methodIntro: 固定长度矩阵按官方服务工具运行；视觉性能点按分辨率固定图像 token，开环容量另行扫描。所有图像相关结论都保持输入形状可见。

The fixed-length matrix uses the official serving benchmark tool; vision points fix image-token counts by resolution, while open-loop capacity is measured separately. Input profiles remain explicit for all image-related conclusions.

methodNotes.zh: EAGLE3/MTP 未运行：该 W8A8 权重中没有可用的 MTP 模块。
methodNotes.en: EAGLE3/MTP was not run because this W8A8 checkpoint does not contain an available MTP module.

methodNotes.zh: 满载 TPOT 会受图执行路径的已知批大小限制影响；不据该点推导单流视觉解码速度。
methodNotes.en: Saturated TPOT is affected by a known graph-execution batch-size limit; it is not used to infer single-stream vision decode speed.
